messages:
jia: Quick mid-Q ownership tally — can folks drop a one-line update for the three cross-team milestones we promised product? 1) KV/prefix caching improvements, 2) Dedicated autoscale policy, 3) Console rollout for rollout/metrics. Please state: shipped/slipped/in-progress, owner, blocker if any. @drew @sam @lee

drew: KV cache: in-progress. Owner: me. Core changes merged (PR: https://git.redwood.io/r/2345) but e2e perf tests flaky. Blocker: intermittent GPU OOM on long sequences — tracing with infra now. ETA: next Tue. :thinking_face:

sam: Autoscale policy: shipped to staging yesterday. Owner: sam. Canary in prod scheduled for Thursday. Need a small quota bump from finance for Dedicated tier tests — @maria can you confirm approval? :eyes:

lee: Console rollout: slipped. Owner: lee. UX work took longer, and dashboard tracing hook landed late. Plan: ship progressive rollout next Wed, but we need a short outage window for schema migration. Blocker: timing with on-call rotation (can't do Wed morning).

maria: finance quota ok for burst tests, confirmed. Also can approve a small contractor to run the stress harness next week if you want faster verification.

drew: quick note on the GPU OOM — stack shows KV cache growth during very long-cot chains. I added a temporary guard in runtime to cap KV memory (config: `max_kv_bytes=5g`) to reduce blast radius. Rollout to staging in 10m. If stable, we can bake into canary.

sam: thanks. I'll coordinate canary window post-bump. pinging @deploy-bot for scheduled canary on Thu 18:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-deploy autoscale-policy v1.3 -> prod at 2028-02-16T18:00:00Z. Reminder will post 1h prior.

lee: re: outage window — can we do the schema migration with no downtime if we run in dual-read mode? I can write the migration script but need infra guardrail for roll-back. @drew can you add a feature flag to disable the new trace fields?

drew: yes I can add a ff. Will create a toggle: `console.new_trace_fields` (off by default). Putting PR up today.

jia: great. Summary for roadmap doc: KV cache — in-progress (drew) ETA Tue, Autoscale — ready for canary Thu (sam) with finance ok, Console — slipped, rollout next Wed pending migration/ff (lee). Actions: @drew add ff + monitor for OOM; @sam confirm canary window post-bump; @lee draft migration script and rollback plan; @maria confirm contractor if needed. If anyone expects new blockers, drop them here. :white_check_mark:

lee: I'll open the migration RFC + rollback checklist today and link it here.

drew: PRs: runtime guard (WIP), ff for console (WIP). I'll post links when ready.

sam: I'll also add a short runbook for autoscale canary steps so SRE knows ramp thresholds.

jia: perfect — thanks all. I'll fold this into the OKR milestone doc and mark shipped/in-progress/slipped accordingly. If no further blockers by EOD Friday we proceed with the planned rollouts. :rocket:
